title: mNET-Seq
scope: Nojima 2015 mammalian NET-seq implementation, with later protocol clarification when appropriate. Extracts the standalone Illumina mNET-Seq schematic and only the mNET-seq row of the supplied poster. The separate 3′NT, NET-Seq and PARE-Seq rows are outside the assigned target. The left descriptive transcription icon is a method emblem, not an additional transformation. The graph starts from prepared native chromatin and ends at the depicted physical cDNA product; sequencing/read mapping are explained as readout interpretation, not added as depicted action blocks. There are no depicted alternative branches or pooling operations.
